_about: Each silhouette's target proportions, for initiative body-type-selection; read by hmcore/character.py. Each range is [least, most]; null is open. waist_hip: waist girth over buttock girth. bust_hip: bust girth over buttock girth. shoulder_hip: bideltoid breadth over hip breadth. Cuts proposed from ANSUR II's percentiles (US Army personnel) and agreed by Rafael on 2026-11-08. Edit to change them.

ansur_proxies._about: ANSUR II means, computed 2026-11-08 from models/ansur-ii: bideltoid breadth over biacromial breadth, and hip breadth over buttock girth. They turn the tape's shoulder width and hip girth into the two breadths shoulder_hip is defined on.
